After two days of debate, the Senate sent the bill back to committee.
Local ordinances wait for a public hearing and a final reading.
The budget went to the board at its spring meeting.
Reconciliation bills get drafted by staff before the vote.

notes: Model pilot (haiku arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole feeds the held pole bonsai1/L33/N5906+ (zeroing this neuron removes 0.76 of the anchor's peak), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. Label and all 16 sentences written by the Haiku 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Probes only partly held: 'two-thirds' (0.44) and 'simple' (0.59) fired, but plain 'by a' (0.23) and 'The' (0.04) did not, and the quiet 'needs a written notice' frame reached 0.35. So the pole responds to the qualifier of a vote threshold, not to 'a' alone, and this label is a context, not a word. The fire and quiet sets are new and should be read as a probable partial.
